individual-data-points.explanation: Panel shows spatial heatmap-style scatter of deconvolution scores per spot; heatmap/spatial-map type plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial scatter/heatmap plot has no error bars or box-whisker elements to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots in this panel have individual data points (dots) overlaid for each biological replicate.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)... [full Q1/Q3/median/minima/maxima values given for each population and group]
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box-whisker elements (quartiles, median, min, max) are explicitly defined with numeric values in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Enrichment score line plots do not display error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar chart of log2 fold-change per gene (with associated p-values implying an underlying statistical comparison) shows only summary bars without any overlaid individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Bars show single log2 fold-change values per gene with no error bars present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel contains H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
